overview: Interactive Docker Compose stack for Server B database replicas — MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis. All credentials and Server A IP are entered at the prompt; nothing is pre-filled.
prerequisites: Server A primary databases configured for replication
Matching passwords for each database engine
Firewall on Server A allows replica IP on DB ports

steps.title: Install Docker host (if needed)
steps.command: sudo apt install himosoft-docker-host && sudo himosoft-docker-host install

steps.title: Install the package
steps.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install himosoft-server-b-replica

steps.title: Initialize replica stack
steps.body: Prompts for Server A IP and database passwords. Writes .env and compose files to /opt/himosoft/server-b-replica.

notes: Passwords must match the primary on Server A
Configure himosoft-firewall on Server A with this server's IP as replica IP
